│ ☐ Config                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                │
│ The loader reads ~/Library/Application Support/Tentacl/settings.json and the key below is missing in older files:│
│                                                                                                                │
│   {                                                                                                            │
│     "scriptsDir": "/Users/you/Documents/GitHub/agent-panel/scripts",                                           │
│     "terminalBackend": "tentacl"                                                                               │
│   }                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                │
│ Should the loader add the key when it is missing?                                                              │
│                                                                                                                │
│ ❯ 1. Add it                                                                                                    │
│     The file gets rewritten once                                                                               │
│   2. Leave the file alone                                                                                      │
│     The default applies in memory                                                                              │
│   3. Type something.                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                │
│   4. Chat about this                                                                                           │
